quarterly_data.signal: Dell's Q1 FY2027 earnings release segment table: AI-optimized servers net revenue rose 757% year over year from $1,882 million in the three months ended May 2, 2025, and Traditional servers and networking net revenue was $4,439 million in that year-ago quarter. The release guided second-quarter FY27 revenue between $44.0 billion and $45.0 billion, up 49% year over year at the midpoint of $44.5 billion.
